digest.component_or_area: LLM completion evidence policy and banking oracle test
propositions: Test oracle _bounded_bank_gaps measures executed filesystem-tool calls but enforcement boundary is denominated in evidence responses, creating structural mismatch post-dd41 commit.
Batching model executes ~11 reads in <=2 evidence responses, never reaching 3-response fallback, causing calls_at_bank=[11,11,11,11,11] signature that violates the executed-call-bounded oracle.
Production behavior (batched governed reads execute; boundary in responses) is intended per dd41-239d-6e09-4a86 deliberate design; the test artifact is defective, not the mechanism.
Re-denominating oracle measurement from executed calls to evidence responses preserves safety intent (incremental banking, bounded gaps, no zero-bank exhaustion) while accepting dd41 batching.
